.gstudio/artifacts/enum/scripts/create/s.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> with the enum's id as the first argument to scaffold the enum file.

.gstudio/artifacts/enum/scripts/list/ste.instruction: Run {{script}} [searchTerm] to list all enums under src/enums, optionally filtered to those whose file contents include the given search term.

.gstudio/artifacts/enum/scripts/update/s.instruction: Run `{{script}} <id> <change-request>` to verify the enum identified by `<id>` exists before applying the change request.

.gstudio/artifacts/enum/scripts/delete/s.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to delete the enum identified by `id`, exiting with an error if it does not exist.
Run {{script}} <id> to print every existing reference to the enum, one per line as `[file path]:[line number]`.

.gstudio/artifacts/enum/scripts/evaluate.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> where <id> is the enum's id (it will be converted to PascalCase to resolve the enum file).

create.text: Scaffolds a new enum file at src/enums/{Name}.enum.ts given an enum id and optional initial members, failing if the file already exists.

list.text: Lists enums under src/enums matching an optional search term and prints each as id: file path.

update.text: Modifies an existing enum file at src/enums/{name}.enum.ts to satisfy a given change request, erroring if the enum does not exist.

delete.text: Deletes an enum by id from src/enums, then finds and removes all dangling references to it in the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that an enum artifact's file location, single top-level definition, and required shape comply with the enum rules, given an enum id.
